summary: Fail scenario story inventory checks closed on symlinked files and directories

replay.detail: No deployed replay or runtime data change.

compatibility.detail: The scenario check expands nested brace alternatives before deriving roots and rejects patterns whose static roots cannot be determined. It rejects symlinks under those roots, including literal file entries, without following them; node_modules is excluded only when the configured pattern does not mention it, matching Storybook. Diagnostics identify the offending path instead of silently omitting linked stories.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
